relationship_to_v1.status: v1 remains frozen, valid and reportable; v2 is a replication under a refined protocol, not a correction.
changes: Block eligibility adds the label-free rule n_services >= 8.
Metrics add many-to-one ACC and the Hungarian bijection penalty.
ARI and NMI are declared undefined, not zero, on single-class blocks.
The clustering methods are unchanged, so the block-rule effect is not confounded with a method change.

method_change_considered_and_rejected.candidate: rare_density_z = 1.25 (or an absolute density-contrast guard tau >= 0.075)
method_change_considered_and_rejected.effect_on_unsw: Removes the block-12 regression; worst paired delta ARI improves from -0.0833 to -0.0018.
method_change_considered_and_rejected.why_rejected: Every setting strong enough to remove the block-12 regression also stops detecting the 25-point rare core in Synthetic-Imbalance (rare-recall 1.000 -> 0.000) and, at tau >= 0.15, Page-blocks as well. The ARI gain is MG-GBC reverting to ARP-GB on the probe designed to demonstrate the mechanism.
method_change_considered_and_rejected.alternative_tried: A corridor-valley rare-core test requiring the segment to the nearest background ball to empty out. It is too aggressive in high dimensions: Digits-Rare rare-recall 0.708 -> 0.500, Page-blocks 0.143 -> 0.000, and the UNSW rare-recall advantage disappears.
method_change_considered_and_rejected.status: Open. The density-contrast statistic does not separate a true rare core from a dense majority fragment, so a cutoff on it cannot fix block 12 without cost.
method_change_considered_and_rejected.recommended_ablation: rare_density_z = 1.0 is the largest cutoff that still detects the Synthetic-Imbalance rare core. On the v2 blocks it gives median delta ARI +0.0049, median delta ACC 0.0000, median delta rare-recall +0.0378 (sign p = 0.0074) and 19/20 non-inferiority, at a cost of Synthetic-SplitRare ARI 1.000 -> 0.991. It does not repair block 12.

relationship_to_v1.pre_registration_caveat: The eligibility statistic was selected by scoring label-free candidates against labels over all 283 v1-eligible buckets. It is therefore informed by v1 outcomes and must be reported as such; the new selection seed and the untouched v1 result are what keep the comparison honest.

purpose: Real-world paired temporal-block benchmark of MG-GBC versus ARP-GB on UNSW-NB15 under a label-free block-heterogeneity rule.
evidence_tier: Expansion of the real-world experiment; not an external-generalization or cross-source claim.

source.name: UNSW-NB15
source.download_surface: Official UNSW SharePoint folder linked by the official page
source.version: No explicit version identifier exposed by the official download surface
source.license_note: Official page grants academic/public research use; commercial use requires agreement with the authors.

observed_source_profile_before_modeling.duplicate_policy: Preserve source rows. No stable Flow ID exists in the full CSVs, and the requested protocol does not authorize outcome- or duplicate-based row deletion. Report duplicate rates as a data-quality caveat.

sampling.eligible_block_rule: At least 5000 source rows with stime in [start, start + 300) AND at least 8 distinct values of the service column in the bucket.
sampling.within_block_sampling: Uniform without replacement using seed 20260827 + block_index after block selection is frozen; no label is consulted.

features.flow_id_status: No Flow ID column exists in the four full official CSV shards.
features.categorical_rule: Per-block ordinal encoding with a missing token; fitted without labels.
features.numeric_missing_rule: Per-block median imputation; all-missing numeric columns become zero.
features.scaling: One common per-block min-max transform is computed once and the identical matrix is passed to both methods with internal scale=False.

mg_gbc_params.rationale: Unchanged from v1 so that v2 isolates the sampling-protocol change.

labels_and_metrics.label_blinding: Labels are indexed only after the block and its 5000 sampled rows are fixed and the feature matrix is frozen.
labels_and_metrics.rare_class_rule: A true class with count < sqrt(5000); recall is computed after Hungarian matching.
labels_and_metrics.acc_reporting_rule: Hungarian ACC is reported together with many-to-one ACC and the unmatched-cluster share, because Hungarian ACC cannot score more clusters than there are classes and therefore conflates over-partitioning with misassignment.
labels_and_metrics.undefined_metric_rule: ARI and NMI are undefined when a block contains a single true class. Such blocks must be excluded from ARI/NMI medians rather than entered as zero.

aggregation.block_level: Save every method result for every selected block.
aggregation.source_level: Take medians across the 20 blocks before any source-level statement.
aggregation.independence_rule: The 20 blocks are repeated samples from one source and must never be counted as 20 independent datasets.

source_level_evaluation.primary_effect: Median paired delta ARI (MG-GBC minus ARP-GB) across the 20 frozen blocks.
secondary_effects: Median paired delta rare-recall on blocks where it is defined
Median paired delta rare-recall on blocks where MG-GBC detects at least one rare core
source_level_evaluation.interpretation: The 20 blocks quantify within-dataset stability and paired performance. They produce one UNSW-NB15 real-world benchmark result and must not be interpreted as 20 independent sources.
source_level_evaluation.cross_source_rules: Not evaluated in this run because only one dataset/source is in scope.

stopping_rule: Run all 20 frozen blocks and report every completed or failed method without block replacement or threshold changes.
